entries.source: BayHStA, Jesuitenorden, Kolleg St. Paul Regensburg Urkunden 1852
entries.summary:
Schuldbrief von Hans Leyrer, Müller auf der mittleren Mühle zu Rosenberg, und seiner Ehefrau Margarethe für Philipp Kemnater zu Hohenkemnath über 30 Rhein. Gulden nicht bezahlter Zinsen und Gülten auf einigen Äckern, die ihnen der Kemnater außerhalb der Mühle überlassen hat, gemäß der mit dem Kemnater erfolgten Verrechnung im Beisein von Georg Pirckner zu Gebertshofen (Gebershoff) und Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg.
S1: Hans Poppenberger, Landschreiber zu Sulzbach, S2: Georg Pirckner zu Gerbertshofen (Gebershoff)

zinss vnd gult, sambt etlichen eckern [?] so vns genanter kembnater ausserhalb der mull desselbs [?]
verlassen, vnd wir erpawt [?] haben, vnd vmb all sachen uff Dinstag [?] Nicolai des Neunzehenden

der gnad vnd nachlassung so vns obgedachter kembnater gethan hat, daruff geloben vnd ver-

kauffen zuuersetzen vnd zuuerkauffen, sich irer schulden dauon [?] geweren
gar vnd gentzlich, wir geloben vnd versprechen auch bey vnsern eren [?] solch
vnser angeaigt [?] erbgerechtigkait uff genanter mull, sambt allen iren [?] gutern
wie vermelt ist ausserhalb obgedachts Phillips kembnater vnd all sein [?] willen vnd wissen
weder verkauffen noch zuuersetzen wellen so lang bisz sie obgenants gelts bezalt
vnd benugig gemacht sindt, trewlich [?] ungeverlich, vnd des zuo [?] hab ich
für mich mein hausfraw vnd all vnser erben die erbern vnd vesten […]sen [?] Pappenperger landt-

entries.english: I, Hanns Leyrer, miller at Rosenberg, resident [?] there at the middle mill, and I, Margaretha, his lawful wife, humbly [?] acknowledge with this open letter, for ourselves and all our heirs and descendants, that we have rightfully and honestly become indebted [?] […] to the noble and steadfast Philipp von Kembnat[…] Hohenkemnat [?], as our [?] lord, his heirs and descendants, namely thirty guilders Rhenish, land's currency, of overdue interest and dues, together with several fields [?] that the said Kemnater left to us outside the mill there [?] and that we have built up [?]; and on all matters on Tuesday [?] St. Nicholas's day of the nineteenth year, in the presence of Jorgen Pirckner [?] Gebershoff and Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg, it was settled with us and reckoned in money, according to his cut note [?], together with the grace and remission that the aforesaid Kemnater has granted us. We promise for ourselves and all our heirs, by virtue of this letter, to pay the said Kemnater and his heirs the said sum, namely six guilders every year on St. Michael's day, eight days before or after, together with the new future interest and dues, and to begin payment on the said St. Michael's day after the date of this letter, until the said thirty guilders are paid […]. For greater security and as a proper pledge we have pledged [?] our hereditary right [?] to the said mill, and moreover all our goods [?] wherever we have or acquire them, nothing excepted, so that, if we do not pay at the term [?], they shall then have full power, authority and good right [to proceed against] the pledge before all other [?] creditors and debtors […] to sell and pledge, and to satisfy [?] their claims fully and entirely. We also promise on our honour [?] not to sell or pledge this our hereditary right to the said mill, together with all [?] goods, as stated, without the knowledge and will of the aforesaid Philipp Kemnater, until they are paid the said money and satisfied, faithfully and without fraud. And for this [?] I, for myself, my wife and all our heirs, have earnestly and with due knowledge asked the honourable and steadfast […]sen [?] Pappenperger, Landschreiber zu Sulzbach, and Jorgen Pirckner of Gebershoff, to press [?] their seals as testimony to this letter, which request and sealing we, the named Pappenperger and Pirckner, acknowledge to have been done.

facts.content: was miller at the middle mill at Rosenberg.

settled accounts with Philipp Kemnater in the presence of Georg Pirckner zu Gebershoff and Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg.
pledged the hereditary right to the middle mill at Rosenberg and all property as security to Philipp Kemnater.
was asked to seal the document.
